{{Quote|Dozoisian Snark Venom. Nice try, Hat Lo.''"</br>"''I'm shocked, shocked. It's poisonous?|Boba Fett and Hat Lo, on the drink served by Ayy Vida|<ref name="Boba Fett: Pursuit" />}}
'''Ayy Vida''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] who was the [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] consort of [[Hat Lo/Legends|Hat Lo]], a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] who kept her under watch with his [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] [[Tas Kee]]. Vida worked as a dancer at the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and used her position at the club to get access to her targets. While at the club in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], she met the [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]] [[Achk Med-Beq/Legends|Achk Med-Beq]] and it was love at first sight for Vida. She hoped that his association with his fellow con artist partner [[Dannl Faytonni/Legends|Dannl Faytonni]] would free her, as she thought Faytonni was a [[Republic officer/Legends|Republic officer]].  

Vida, Med-Beq, and her Twi'lek acquaintance [[Lunae Minx/Legends|Lunae Minx]] had an impromptu chat when the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] visited the club searching for the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]]. Soon after, Vida went to entertain Lo's clients. Years later in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Vida was present in Lo's Coruscant [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], [[Sign of the Tri-Forked Tongue]], where she served bounty hunter [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] [[Dozoisian Snark Venom]] during his visit for weapons. 

==Biography==
===Assassin and dancer===
[[File:Outlander_Club.png|thumb|right|350px|Ayy Vida worked at the Outlander Club (pictured).]]
Ayy Vida was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]]<ref name="DB" /> [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] who doubled as a dancer at the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]],<ref name="Galactic Files" /> a [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall located in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] of the<ref name="Outlander">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="aotcvis">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Outlander" /> Vida used her skills and her position at the club to gain access to her targets.<ref name="Galactic Files" /> The club was visited by<ref name="FF44">{{FactFile|44|COR 21-22|Coruscant &ndash; Outlander Club}}</ref> [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]]<ref name="CSWE2">{{CSWECite|II|258|Lo, Hat}}</ref> [[Hat Lo/Legends|Hat Lo]],<ref name="DB" /> whom Vida was a long working<ref name="DB" /> [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]]<ref name="CSWE" /> consort for.<ref name="DB" /> 

Vida was kept under watch by crime lord's [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] enforcer [[Tas Kee]],<ref name="FF">{{FactFile|96|OUT 1-2|Outlander Nightclub Patrons}}</ref> and dreamed of being rescued from<ref name="CSWE" /> the forced<ref name="FF" /> servitude,<ref name="CSWE" /> and would have left the crime lord, if it wasn't for her fear of of being hunted down by Kee.<ref name="CSWE" /> Vida also frequented the Outlander but had no love for the place. Her Twi'lek acquaintance, [[Lunae Minx/Legends|Lunae Minx]], often visited the club to say hello to Vida.<ref name="FF" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="22 BBY">The [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] 13:2:28 corresponds to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> Vida appeared in a [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] advertisement for [[Spysprite mini-holocam]]s.<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsAd|url=meta/img/ads/600_1.gif|text=Spysprite mini-holocam}}</ref>

===Love at first sight===
During a night<ref name="EP2">{{Film|II}}</ref> later in 22 BBY,<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> Vida was visiting the Outlander Club,<ref name="DB" /> when the [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]] [[Achk Med-Beq/Legends|Achk Med-Beq]],<ref name="Galactic Files" /> dressed in the uniform of a [[Republic Security Force|Republic Guard]], entered. The two locked [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]<ref name="DB" /> and it was love at first sight for Vida.<ref name="scrapbook">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Scrapbook]]''</ref> Meeting him, she thought for sure that she would be able to leave behind her life.<ref name="Galactic Files" /> Vida hoped that his association with<ref name="CSWE" /> fellow con artist<ref name="Faytonni">{{DB|character|lieutenantfaytonni|Faytonni, Lieutenant Dannl}}</ref> [[Dannl Faytonni/Legends|Dannl Faytonni]], whom she believed was a Republic officer who could free her from enslavement, would allow her to meet him.<ref name="CSWE" /> However, her hope was vain as Med-Beq was a poseur who frequented clubs for his own nefarious purposes.<ref name="Figure">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars (Hasbro toy line)|packtype='03 Basic Figure|pack=#38: Ayy Vida (Outlander Nightclub Patron)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/sw0338ayyvida.asp}}</ref> 

[[File:AyyLunaeAchk-AOTC.png|thumb|left|400px|Vida, Med-Beq, and Minx's attention was drawn by the Jedi.]]
When the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] entered the club searching for the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]], Vida, Med-Beq, and Minx had an<ref name="EP2" /> impromptu<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|75|Who's Who in the Outlander Club: It's Ladies' Night}}</ref> chat while standing at a table,<ref name="EP2" /> during which she tried to convince Med-Beq to take her offworld.<ref name="Chronicles" /> When Kenobi sliced Wesell's [[Limb/Legends|arm]] off with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], the group turned to stare at the situation. The Padawan told the clubgoers to go back to their drinks and the group left the club.<ref name="EP2" /> While Wesell was interrogated outside the club, Vida moved to a table to entertain Lo's clients.<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="CSWE" /> that started shortly after her visit,<ref name="EP2" /> Vida frequented the bars and nightclubs of Coruscant.<ref name="CSWE" /> 

===Boba Fett arrives===
[[File:BobaFettFull-OP.png|thumb|right|200px|Boba Fett (pictured) arrived at the Sign of the Tri-Forked Tongue.]]
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Boba Fett: Pursuit]]'' to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> the young bounty hunter [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] was invited by Lo to the [[Sign of the Tri-Forked Tongue]], a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]] ran by the crime lord. Fett sought out weapons for his planned confrontation with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]. Standing next to a [[Codru-Ji]] bouncer blocking the club's doorway, Vida yawned before the bounty hunter announced that he was here to see Lo. Vida blinked, then quietly slipped away. Fett was waved in by the bouncer and he approached Lo.<ref name="Boba Fett: Pursuit">''[[Boba Fett: Pursuit]]''</ref>

As Fett would not speak to Lo with his Codru-Ji bodyguards, the crime lord commanded his bodyguards to go. Lo asked Fett to sit and Vida, almost magically, appeared at his shoulder, carrying two beakers of fizzing liquid. Lo took one drink while the Twi'lek offered the other to Fett. The crime lord exclaimed for Fett to drink with him and raised his drink, waiting for the bounty hunter to do the same. Fett declined at dumped his drink's contents on the floor, identifying the drink as [[Dozoisian Snark Venom]]. Lo feigned surprise and handed his drink back to Vida, then glared at her while she made a hasty retreat.<ref name="Boba Fett: Pursuit" /> 

After the attempted poisoning, the topic made a change to the weapons Fett sought out. The bounty hunter agreed to buy the [[Flechette pistol/Legends|flechette pistol]] and the [[CryoBan grenade/Legends|CryoBan grenades]] Lo had on hand. Vida then reentered the room with a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] carrying the weapons. After examining the weapons closely, Fett approved of them. Lo dismissed Vida and the Bothan and Fett began armoring himself.<ref name="Boba Fett: Pursuit" /> 

==Personality and traits==
[[File:AyyVida-OfficialFactFile68.png|thumb|left|225px|Ayy Vida was unusual among Twi'leks for her skin tone.]]
Like several other young Twi'lek women, Vida's living was affected in part by the criminal underworld.<ref name="DB" /> She was dissatisfied with her life as a consort to Hat Lo and sought to escape,<ref name="Galactic Files" /> only being discouraged by her fear of Tas Kee.<ref name="DB" /> The Twi'lek dreamed of being rescued from the servitude<ref name="CSWE" /> she grew to despise,<ref name="Galactic Files" /> liking nothing more than to escape Coruscant and Lo's grasp. Her<ref name="FF" /> sad<ref name="Insider" /> life was not all bad, as fellow Twi'leks came by the Outlander Club to say hello to her.<ref name="FF" /> One of the Twi'leks was<ref name="FF" /> her acquaintance<ref name="DB" /> Lunae Minx.<ref name="FF" /> Another acquaintance of Vida's was Achk Med-Beq,<ref name="DB" /> with whom it was love at first sight for the Twi'lek.<ref name="scrapbook" /> She hoped their connection would allow her to meet Dannl Faytonni, a man who she thought could free her.<ref name="CSWE" />

A slender<ref name="Boba Fett: Pursuit" /> Twi'lek female,<ref name="DB" /> Vida's appearance was unusual among her species,<ref name="CSWE" /> and was set apart from uniformly [[Color/Legends|pigmented]] Twi'lek's as her<ref name="DB" /> yellow skin featured a<ref name="CSWE" /> mottled pattern<ref name="DB" /> of orange stripes.<ref name="DB" /> Vida had brown eyes and was also considered beautiful.<ref name="DB" /> She had a female Twi'lek name that meant "star." Her clan surname meant "pleasing to the senses."<ref name="GalacticCampaign">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

==Skills and abilities==
The Twi'lek had average intelligence, slightly-below average speed, and low diplomacy skills, strength, and fighting ability. She was not [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]].<ref name="Galactic Files" />

==Equipment==
During her visit to the Outlander Club, Vida wore a yellow and orange patterned [[Clothing/Legends|bodysuit]] that enhanced her skin color, a silver headdress, and silver heels.<ref name="Chronicles">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I've never looked like this before. I have been airbrushed all over.|Karina Wakefield, speaking about her costume|audio=KarinaWakefield-Costume.flac|<ref name="ATBP">{{SW|url=video/a-twinkle-beyond-pluto|series=Making Episode II Webdocs|text=Part 5: A Twinkle Beyond Pluto}}</ref>}}
[[File:Ayy_Vida_offstage.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Karina Wakefield, with actor [[Anthony Daniels]]]]
Ayy Vida first appeared in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']],<ref name="EP2" /> which released on May 16, 2002.<ref name="Year">''[[Star Wars Year by Year: A Visual Chronicle]]''</ref> [[Dermot Power]] created concept art<ref name="ArtofII">''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> of the character.<ref name="DB" /> One piece with the production code "dp239" depicted the character with green skin and wearing beige clothes with fishnet sleeves and high black boots<ref name="DPower">{{WebCite|url=https://dermotpower.com/star-wars-episode-2attack-of-the-clones|text=Star Wars Episode 2:Attack of the Clones|work=[[Dermot Power]]'s website|archivedate=20260211111619}}</ref> and one depicted her with blue skin and red clothes with black sleeves.<ref name="ArtofII" /> The Outlander Club scenes including Vida, who was portrayed by [[Karina Wakefield]],<ref name="DtG">''[[Dressing a Galaxy: The Costumes of Star Wars]]''</ref> were shot at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]] on [[July 17]], [[2000]].<ref name="Mythmaking">''[[Mythmaking: Behind the Scenes of Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> Wakefield's costume was airbrushed all over for her part as Vida.<ref name="ATBP" /> 

The character was first pictured when Wakefield, in costume, introduced the third episode of the Episode II behind-the-scenes video series [[On location|''on location'']].<ref name="On location">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/bts/onloc/3.html|series=On Location|text=Part 3 - Creative People Producing Solutions}}</ref> The episode, "Creative People Producing Solutions," was released on [[August 15]], 2000.<ref name="Archive">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/bts/onloc/archive.html|text=''on location'' archive}}</ref> Vida was first identified in the StarWars.com article "Extras, Extras: Ros Breden," which was published on [[January 31]], 2002.<ref name="Extras, Extras:">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/bts/profile/f20020131/index.html|text=Extras, Extras: Ros Breden}}</ref>

Several Twi'leks in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]'', including [[Romi Moola]], [[B'inka Fibuna]], and [[Eela Valotta]], are textured similarly to Vida, sharing her skin tone, eye color, and clothing. The game was published by [[LucasArts]]<ref name="BH">''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref> on [[November 22]], 2002.<ref name="Year" /> In the article "[[Who's Who in the Outlander Club: It's Ladies' Night|Who's Who in the Outlander Club: It's Ladies' Night,]]" published in the [[Star Wars Insider 75|seventy-fifth]] issue of ''[[Star Wars Insider]]''<ref name="Insider" /> on [[April 6]], [[2004]],<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20040315.html|text=The New Face of Evil}}</ref> author [[Daniel Wallace]] stated that Vida was ''[[Star Wars]]''{{'s}} first tiger-striped Twi'lek, and speculated that the character's name was a blenderized version of the name of [[Fay David]], Episode II's art supervisor.<ref name="Insider" />
